Original User Story: I want to describe myself on my own page in a semi-structured way, so that others can learn about me.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As an individual, I want to develop a well-organized yet adaptable profile overview on my personal site so that visitors can quickly grasp my background and interests.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Include key sections such as a personal biography, a list of skills, and a description of hobbies.
- Create a visually appealing and user-friendly layout for optimal engagement.
- Allow for easy content updates to keep the information current and relevant.

Test Outline:
- Review the webpage to ensure all key sections are present and logically structured.
- Assess the visual design for effectiveness and user navigation ease.
- Verify the functionality of the content update feature to ensure modifications can be made smoothly.

Original User Story: I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Practitioner, so that I can earn that designation.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As an aspiring Scrum professional, I want to complete an application for the Certified Scrum Practitioner designation so that I can achieve this credential and enhance my career prospects.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Successfully submit the application form with all required information
- Receive confirmation of application submission
- Obtain the certification upon meeting all necessary requirements

Test Outline:
- Verify that the application form can be filled out and submitted without issues
- Check for a confirmation email or notification after submission
- Ensure that the certification is awarded upon fulfilling the criteria

Original User Story: As a Practitioner, I want to include additional details about me in my profile page, so that I can showcase my experience.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a Practitioner, I want to enrich my profile page with more comprehensive information about my background, so that I can effectively highlight my expertise and experience to potential clients or employers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Provide fields for adding certifications, skills, and work history.
- Ensure that the profile updates are saved and displayed correctly.
- Allow users to preview changes before finalizing their profile updates.

Test Outline:
- Verify that all new fields for additional details are functional and user-friendly.
- Check that updates are accurately reflected on the profile after saving.
- Test the preview feature to ensure it displays the profile accurately before submission.

Original User Story: As a site member, I want to fill out an application to become a Certified Scrum Trainer, so that I can teach CSM and CSPO courses and certify others.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site member, I aim to finalize my application for Scrum Trainer certification, which will empower me to teach CSM and CSPO courses and certify future professionals in the field.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Successfully complete and submit the application for Scrum Trainer certification.
- Receive a confirmation notification indicating the application has been submitted.
- Get updates regarding the application status within a defined timeframe.

Test Outline:
- Ensure the application form is user-friendly and can be submitted without any complications.
- Confirm receipt of an acknowledgment email that verifies the application submission.
- Track the response time for feedback on the application status to ensure it aligns with the specified timeframe.

Original User Story: As a Trainer, I want to include additional details in my profile page about me, so that others can learn about me and decide if I am the right trainer for them.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a Trainer, I want to enrich my profile page with detailed personal information so that potential clients can better understand my qualifications and assess whether I meet their training needs.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Create distinct sections highlighting my certifications, work history, and training philosophy.
- Include a personal statement that conveys my distinctive training approach and techniques.
- Design the profile to be visually appealing and intuitive for seamless navigation.

Test Outline:
- Review the profile page to confirm the inclusion of the new sections.
- Assess the clarity and impact of the personal statement.
- Analyze the overall design and user-friendliness of the profile layout.

Original User Story: As the site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have substantial control over the article's layout and design so that the content is visually engaging and attractive to readers.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Ability to customize font styles and sizes for headings and body text
- Options to adjust image placements and sizes within the article
- Tools to format text with bullet points, quotes, and other styling features

Test Outline:
- Verify that the editor can change font styles and sizes effectively
- Check that images can be repositioned and resized as intended
- Ensure that text formatting options are functional and enhance article presentation

Original User Story: As a site editor, I want to create the content of the What Is Scrum section, so that it's there for visitors.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to develop the "What Is Scrum" section so that it provides valuable information for site visitors.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Draft and finalize the content for the "What Is Scrum" section.
- Ensure the content is engaging and informative for the target audience.
- Publish the section on the website for public access.

Test Outline:
- Review the drafted content for clarity and relevance.
- Confirm that the section is live on the website and accessible to users.
- Gather feedback from visitors to assess the effectiveness of the content.
